# Blanket

Also asked as: backdrop, scrim.

**Import:** `import { Blanket } from '@/patterns';`

**Used in:** Frame (`ds guide frame`); Panel (`ds guide panel`); Modal (`ds guide modal`); Popup (`ds guide popup`)

**Governed by:** Notifications (`ds guide notifications`)

**Source:** `design-system/src/patterns/Blanket/Blanket.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/patterns/Blanket/Blanket.stories.jsx` — Inline, ConfirmOverPanel, Layers, Pads, ScreenGrid, Interactive, MotionOpenClose, MotionReduced

**Motion:** enter `appearance.default` · exit `appearance.fast`. Read the tokens through `--ds-motion-*`; see Foundations › Expression › Motion.

## Motion

Blanket reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| enter | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-appearance-default` | The Blanket dims on the same fade as the layer it sits under. |
| exit | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | It fades with the layer; a docked Panel never has one. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `show` | bool | `true` | Keep mounted and set false to finish the exit before removal. |
| `inline` | bool | `false` | Draw in the page flow at a stand-in screen, for docs and previews, instead of fixed over the page. |
| `screenWidth` | number | — | Inline only: the screen width (px) the layers inside take their width from, such as 768, 1024 or 1440. |
| `screenHeight` | number | — | Inline only: the screen height (px); a layer inside caps at it less Blanket/pad-y above and below. The pad follows the real viewport (24 under 640 tall), not this height, as Figma's frames do. |
| `onBlanketClick` | func | — | Called for a click on the blanket, not on the layer it holds. |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
| `style` | object | — | — |
| `children` | node | — | The layer it holds: a PatternModal, or a confirm over one. |
